title: Stock Analysis Input
description: Contract file passed from screening/ranking into the deterministic analyzer and analysis Skill.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema contract. Unknown versions fail closed until their source and PIT rules are reviewed.

screening_engine_version.description: Engine version. Use vMAJOR.MINOR or vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, for example v7.5 or v7.6.1.

l3_mode.description: Which L3 cat_score source was used to rank this pool. Absence = legacy file (pre-v1.1); treat as 'today' for backward compat.

l3_pit_strict.description: With l3_mode=pit, whether missing snapshot was a fatal error (true) or a soft fallback to cat_score=50 (false).

l3_snapshot_date.description: Actual L3 snapshot date read or written by this run. For pit it must be <= trade_date; neutralize may be null.

l3_provider.description: Provider provenance for the L3 graph. A live today run uses hithink_finance; legacy snapshots retain their explicit legacy label.

l3_coverage.description: Complete-catalog receipt. A board may be skipped only when the API explicitly returned an empty item list.

runtime_configuration.description: Reviewed JSON policy set consumed by this screening run. Official current artifacts carry it so weekly M6.7 can reject a policy change or cross-run configuration mix-up.

excluded_counts.description: L0 hard-veto counts consumed by the weekly exclusion summary. Legacy v1.4 artifacts may also contain the three explicitly compatible rank-exclusion keys.

rank_exclusion_counts.description: Post-L0 ranking-stage eliminations; separate from excluded_counts, which is consumed as L0 hard-veto counts by the weekly report.

iv_value.description: Unit: percent or index points depending on IV source.

available_cash.description: Unit: CNY for A-share preset accounts.

total_equity.description: Unit: CNY for A-share preset accounts.

current_gross_exposure.description: Unit: CNY for A-share preset accounts.

allOf.description: Margin source coverage is mandatory for newly emitted 1.3.0 A-short inputs.
Files emitted under schema_version 1.1.0 must include L3 mode metadata. Legacy 1.0.0 files remain valid for read-back.
Current 1.2.0 A-short outputs require explicit provider and coverage lineage for every L3 mode.

close.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

current_price.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

open.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

low.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

pre_close.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

price_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the quoted price. EOD A-share examples use 15:00:00+08:00.

industry_trend_signal.description: Structured deterministic SW L2 industry-trend signal classified from the existing EGS industry_heat_score. It is independent of the LLM fundamental/policy advisory.

industry_trend_evidence.description: Deprecated compatibility field for older advisory artifacts. It is not consumed by the deterministic industry_trend classifier or M6.7 decisions.

industry_heat_score.description: Unit: points, 0-100. SW L2 industry heat (cross-industry percentile). Optional; emitted by EGS once the industry_heat promotion ships; null/absent for older artifacts.

drawdown_20d.description: Unit: percent, negative means drawdown from 20-day high.

high_20d.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

low_20d.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

avg_amount_5d.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; recent 5-trading-day average traded amount.

avg_amount_20d.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; recent 20-trading-day average traded amount.

yesterday_amount.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; previous trading day traded amount.

atr_14.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

lower.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

limit_up_count_10d.description: Unit: times in the last 10 trading days.

limit_up_count_20d.description: Unit: times in the last 20 trading days.

pct_5d_n.description: Unit: percent, 1 means 1%. EGS normalized/processed 5-trading-day return used for scoring.

pct_20d_n.description: Unit: percent, 1 means 1%. EGS normalized/processed 20-trading-day return used for scoring.

q0_net_income.description: Unit: CNY. A-short compatibility field: intentionally unavailable because the batched income endpoint is not supported. Retained as nullable for schema compatibility; not a live decision input. Quality checks use q0_dt_profit_ratio and ttm_profit_dedt with ttm_ocf_ratio; q0_profit_dedt remains a batch-derived companion output.

q0_dt_profit_ratio.description: Unit: Tushare source convention; exporter does not normalize.

esp_raw.description: Unit: EGS internal raw expectation score.

avg_amount_5d.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; recent 5-trading-day average traded amount.

avg_amount_20d.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; recent 20-trading-day average traded amount.

yesterday_amount.description: Unit: CNY for A-shares; previous trading day traded amount.

target_price_mean.description: Unit: CNY/share for A-shares or USD/share for US equities.

vol_confirm.description: Volume-confirmation flag (EGS-computed: up-amount > down-amount over last 5d). Optional; null/absent for older artifacts. Feeds EGS l4_score only; since #6-ii it NO LONGER gates Phase 5 breakout entry (breakout now driven by is_breakout = v14.2 spec: close>=MA10 and same-day amount > 5d-avg*1.2).

numberNullable.description: Nullable number. Field-level description defines the unit.

ratioNullable.description: Nullable non-negative ratio. Field-level description defines the unit.

scoreNullable.description: Nullable score, unit: points, valid range 0-100.

nonNegativeIntegerNullable.description: Nullable non-negative integer. Field-level description defines the unit.
